metadata.description: FamilyLore, LexiTrail, StockMap and WithBy for Claude Code

plugins.name: familylore
plugins.description: Reads handwritten family letters in old scripts (Russian and Ukrainian cursive, German Kurrent and Sütterlin, Yiddish) and translates them, with notes on what they meant at the time.

plugins.name: lexitrail
plugins.description: Look up any Chinese word with its pinyin, meaning, HSK level, stroke order and sound, and keep track of the HSK words you are learning on LexiTrail.

plugins.name: stockmap
plugins.description: Every night StockMap's model makes a call on over 4,000 US stocks and keeps a public record of how each call turned out. See a stock's call, the reasons for and against, its record, and the whole market as a map.

plugins.name: withby
plugins.description: Washington's mountain-pass conditions, checked every few minutes, and hundreds of short stories about the places along the road, told by Sal, WithBy's narrator.
